summary: Creative Global Technology Holdings, a foreign private issuer, furnished Form 6-K to announce an extraordinary general meeting on September 9, 2026. Proposals include adopting a fourth amended memorandum and articles of association, modifying written resolution rules, establishing exclusive jurisdiction for certain claims, and updating authorized share capital to US$900,000 split into Class A and B shares. Authorization for administrative implementation and potential adjournment are also sought. This is a routine corporate governance matter and shareholder meeting notice, not a special situation; no deal terms or strategic event are involved. No special-situation category applies; the filing merely updates corporate charter and convenes a meeting.
